instruction: Candid wedding photograph from a high-angle full shot looking down at an outdoor paved path bordered by stone tiles. The bride in a white wedding gown (R1) walks on the left, holding hands with the groom in a white tuxedo jacket and black trousers (R2) who walks on the right. Both are moving forward together, with the bride looking downward and the groom glancing toward her. Bright daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the pavement and highlighting the clean white of their wedding attire.
